name: Thyme
summary: Soups and stews. Bees love its flowers.
description: Thyme is a compact, fragrant herb with tiny leaves and delicate flowers.
usefulInformation: Add to soups, beans, stews and vegetable roasts.
healthBenefits: Contains thymol and other aromatic compounds; clinical effects depend on preparation and dose.
medicinalUses: Traditionally used in herbal teas for seasonal comfort.

additionalInformation.growingTips: Grow in well-drained soil and adjust watering and sunlight to local conditions.
additionalInformation.harvesting: Harvest gently, leaving enough growth for the plant to recover.
additionalInformation.gardenNote: A useful addition to a kitchen and pollinator-friendly herb garden.
